_comment: THE NEGATIVE CONTROL FOR MTG_EDF_GOFF_LIB_DEPTH -- the same board, and no wish to find.
edf_co_22's board exactly (the user's claude_s6_gi5 ordinal 8: Eldrazi Displacer under
Training Grounds, two Peregrine Drakes, a Cloud of Faeries, three lands worth six, empty
hand), with every Living Wish REMOVED from the library.  Nothing else differs.
This is what makes the widening safe to ship rather than merely favourable.  Scanning the
whole library instead of its top twenty must find a finisher route that is REALLY THERE; on a
board whose library holds no wish and no {T}-less finisher, ScanHandSinks still returns
nothing, FlickerGoOffCount still sizes nothing, and the button must still be absent -- with
the lever ON, which is the state this fixture runs in.
It also pins the second half of the same claim: the widening did NOT quietly enable
FlickerGoOffCount's DRAW-LAND route in human play.  That route ('loop, draw my own library
down to one card') would size a count on this very board -- Kitchen is a {4},{T} Investigate
and the loop untaps it every pass -- and it is deliberately search-only
(DrawLandGoOffOn: `if (HumanPlayActive()) { return false; }`), because it prices no kill
whatsoever.  If it ever leaks into human play this fixture goes red.
